description: This source file defines the class MoneyOrderPayment, which implements the PaymentModule interface and provides transactional methods specific to money order payments within a payment integration module.

classes.name: MoneyOrderPayment
classes.description: A class that implements the PaymentModule interface to handle money order payment transactions, including configuration validation and transaction initialization.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the integration configuration by checking the presence of the 'address' key.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a transaction, but is not required for money order payments, returns null.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Authorization method stub, not required for this payment type, returns null.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Transaction object with the type AUTHORIZECAPTURE, sets amount and date.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating refund is not supported.
